requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement contains no linguistic ambiguity but exhibits concern-mixing (functional action + quality criterion). Decomposed into two separate artefacts per Pohl §25.2: a functional requirement for the save action and a quality requirement for the confirmation message display.

source_fragments: When the user selects the Save option, the system shall write the current document to disk.

fields.condition: the user selects the Save option

structured_requirements.final_statement: When the user selects the Save option, the system shall write the current document to disk.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action (write to disk) from the original sentence. Removed the quality criterion regarding the confirmation message.

fields.condition: after writing the current document to disk

structured_requirements.final_statement: After writing the current document to disk, the system shall display a confirmation message.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (display confirmation message) as a separate artefact. Classified as a quality requirement to distinguish the functional write action from the user feedback mechanism.
